neet_phy_u06_t05_1.working: In a circular orbit, total energy E = -KE, so E = -5×10^9 J.

neet_phy_u06_t05_2.working: By Kepler's third law, T ∝ r^{3/2}. Then T2 = 2 h × 4^{3/2} = 2 × 8 = 16 h.

neet_phy_u06_t05_3.working: KE = GMm/2r, so KE decreases as r increases. E = -GMm/2r becomes less negative, so total energy increases.

neet_phy_u06_t05_4.working: KE = GMm/2r (IV); PE = -GMm/r (I); E = -GMm/2r (III). Energy needed = -GMm/4r - (-GMm/2r) = GMm/4r (II).

neet_phy_u06_t05_5.working: A is true. B is false: gravity is not zero; the astronauts are in free fall. C is true: about 7.9 km/s and about 84 min. D is false: v = sqrt(GM/r), independent of the satellite's mass. E is true.
